name: dsh-argp
description: Guarded context compaction for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): the LLM proposes, deterministic guards dispose — eager per-atom shrink (extract/summary/false under verbatim guards) + lazy reference-graph eviction (0-LLM) + byte-exact recall from an append-only log. 守卫式上下文压缩：LLM 只提议、确定性守卫裁决——逐原子缩放 + 惰性引用图剪枝（0-LLM）+ 追加式日志逐字节召回；压缩率精确兑现，历史永不销毁。
